h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jalna

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jalna

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Jalna

c: Water is short in Marathwada for much of the year, and in a town like Jalna an outdoor gym should need as little upkeep as possible. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, housing colonies, industrial campuses and municipal gardens in Jalna. We make the machines at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 320 km away, and send them by road.

Our machines need no water, power or regular servicing to run. A periodic wipe, a bolt check and a look at moving parts is enough for most sites. Jalna's summers are hot and dry, with dust in the air before the monsoon. Our installers or a local dealer fix them, grouted or self-standing depending on your soil. Tell us the size of your ground and who will use it. We will suggest machines and mark them on a layout drawing.

items.q: How much maintenance does an outdoor gym need?
items.a: Very little. Wipe the machines, check bolts and look at moving parts every few weeks. We hand over simple maintenance steps after installation.

items.q: How are machines fixed on black cotton soil?
items.a: We grout the base in concrete set below the soft top layer. This keeps the machine level when the soil swells in the rains and shrinks in summer.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms in Jalna?
items.a: Yes. Jalna is about 320 km from our Vasai factory. We deliver by road and install through our own team or a local dealer.
